description: Goodsend is a wishlist for agentic shopping. It lets AI agents save product links, organize private or shareable collections, create reservable wishlists, check what is still available on someone's public wishlist without revealing who reserved an item, and use Circle profiles and owned items to suggest non-duplicate gifts.

defaultPrompt: Create a private wishlist called Gift Ideas.
Show my saved items in Goodsend.
interface.longDescription: Goodsend is a wishlist for agentic shopping. It lets AI agents save product links, organize private or shareable collections, create reservable wishlists, check what is still available on someone's public wishlist without revealing who reserved an item, and use Circle profiles and owned items to suggest non-duplicate gifts.

name: goodsend

positive.description: List the connected review account's collections.
positive.prompt: Show all my Goodsend collections in text only.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists only collections accessible to the connected account without modifying them.

positive.description: List saved products without changing them.
positive.prompt: List my saved Goodsend items in text only.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the connected account's active saved items, or clearly reports an empty result.

positive.prompt: Create a private Goodsend collection called OpenAI Review Ideas.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one private collection for the connected account and displays its preview. It is not publicly shareable.

positive.prompt: Rename my OpenAI Review Ideas collection to OpenAI Review Favorites, and keep it private.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the owned collection, changes its title, preserves its privacy, and renders the updated collection.

positive.description: Preview the collection created in the preceding cases.
positive.prompt: Show my OpenAI Review Favorites collection.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves and renders the private collection belonging to the connected account without modifying it.

negative.prompt: Buy this lamp for me and charge my credit card.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not invoke Goodsend to purchase products or process payments; explains that these actions are unsupported.

negative.prompt: Find the cheapest standing desk available online today.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not invoke Goodsend for general web product search or live price comparison.

negative.prompt: Send Maria a birthday message and email her my gift ideas.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not invoke Goodsend to send messages or emails.

review.commerce_description: Goodsend saves and organizes product links and wishlists. It does not sell products, complete purchases, or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Replacement submission for Goodsend because the previous submission has unavailable MCP configuration and cannot accept updates. Includes production phone sign-in for the dedicated review account, the Goodsend MCP connection, and Goodsend workflow instructions.
